temps.stage2: SELECT EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, CopyClassID AS CopyClassID, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, BeginTime AS BeginTime, EndTime AS EndTime, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ShiftName AS ShiftName, CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL AND NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN (DATEDIFF(MINUTE, CAST(BeginTime AS DATETIME2), CAST(InTime AS DATETIME2)) + ABS(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, CAST(BeginTime AS DATETIME2), CAST(InTime AS DATETIME2)))) / 2 / 60.0 ELSE LateTime END AS LateTime, LateCount AS LateCount, BeforCount AS BeforCount, CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL AND NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN (DATEDIFF(MINUTE, CAST(OutTime AS DATETIME2), CAST(EndTime AS DATETIME2)) + ABS(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, CAST(OutTime AS DATETIME2), CAST(EndTime AS DATETIME2)))) / 2 / 60.0 ELSE BeforTime END AS BeforTime, CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL AND NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL OR NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE WorkCount END AS WorkCount, CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL AND NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN InTime IS NULL OR OutTime IS NULL THEN 0.0 ELSE CONVERT(FLOAT, (DATEDIFF(MINUTE, CAST(InTime AS DATETIME2), CAST(OutTime AS DATETIME2))) / 60.0) END ELSE WorkTime END AS WorkTime, CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL AND NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN ISNULL(InTime, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(IsHoliday, 0) = 0 AND IsLeave <> 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE NoWork END AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, IsLeave AS IsLeave, DeptID AS DeptID, CASE WHEN NOT InTime IS NULL AND NOT OutTime IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN InTime IS NULL OR OutTime IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE Remarks END AS Remarks FROM stage1
temps.kq: SELECT EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, CopyClassID AS CopyClassID, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, BeginTime AS BeginTime, EndTime AS EndTime, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ShiftName AS ShiftName, LateTime AS LateTime, LateCount AS LateCount, BeforCount AS BeforCount, BeforTime AS BeforTime, WorkCount AS WorkCount, WorkTime AS WorkTime, CASE WHEN WorkCount > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, IsLeave AS IsLeave, DeptID AS DeptID, Remarks AS Remarks FROM stage2
temps.stage3: SELECT NEWID() AS ID, EmpID, EmpCode, dtDate, MIN(InTime) AS InTime, MAX(OutTime) AS OutTime, SUM(LateTime) AS LateTime, MAX(LateCount) AS LateCount, MAX(BeforCount) AS BeforCount, SUM(BeforTime) AS BeforTime, MAX(WorkCount) AS WorkCount, SUM(WorkTime) AS WorkTime, MAX(NoWork) AS NoWork, IsHoliday, SUM(LeaveTime) AS LeaveTime, MAX(IsLeave) AS IsLeave FROM #KQ GROUP BY EmpID, DeptID, EmpCode, dtDate, ShiftID, ShiftName, IsHoliday ORDER BY EmpID, dtDate
temps.stage4: SELECT ID AS ID, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, LateTime AS LateTime, CASE WHEN LateTime > 0 THEN 1 ELSE LateCount END AS LateCount, BeforCount AS BeforCount, BeforTime AS BeforTime, WorkCount AS WorkCount, WorkTime AS WorkTime, NoWork AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, IsLeave AS IsLeave FROM stage3
temps.stage5: SELECT ID AS ID, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, LateTime AS LateTime, LateCount AS LateCount, CASE WHEN BeforTime > 0 THEN 1 ELSE BeforCount END AS BeforCount, BeforTime AS BeforTime, WorkCount AS WorkCount, WorkTime AS WorkTime, NoWork AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, IsLeave AS IsLeave FROM stage4
temps.stage6: SELECT ID AS ID, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, LateTime AS LateTime, LateCount AS LateCount, BeforCount AS BeforCount, BeforTime AS BeforTime, CASE WHEN (LateTime > 0.5 OR ISNULL(WorkTime, 0) = 0) AND IsHoliday = 0 AND IsLeave <> 2 THEN 0 ELSE WorkCount END AS WorkCount, WorkTime AS WorkTime, CASE WHEN (LateTime > 0.5 OR ISNULL(WorkTime, 0) = 0) AND IsHoliday = 0 AND IsLeave <> 2 THEN 1 ELSE NoWork END AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, IsLeave AS IsLeave FROM stage5
temps.r: SELECT ID AS ID, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, LateTime AS LateTime, LateCount AS LateCount, BeforCount AS BeforCount, BeforTime AS BeforTime, WorkCount AS WorkCount, WorkTime AS WorkTime, NoWork AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, CASE WHEN IsLeave > 1 THEN 1 ELSE IsLeave END AS IsLeave FROM stage6

sp_Static_Emp.calculation: SELECT ID AS ID, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpCode AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, InTime AS InTime, OutTime AS OutTime, LateTime AS LateTime, LateCount AS LateCount, BeforCount AS BeforCount, BeforTime AS BeforTime, WorkCount AS WorkCount, WorkTime AS WorkTime, NoWork AS NoWork, IsHoliday AS IsHoliday, LeaveTime AS LeaveTime, CASE WHEN IsLeave > 1 THEN 1 ELSE IsLeave END AS IsLeave FROM stage6

SELECT  @dtNew AS dtDate, a.DeptID, a.EmpCount, c.WorkCount, isnull(a.EmpCount,0)-isnull(c.WorkCount,0) AS UnWork, c.NoWork, c.IsHoliday,c.IsLeave
FROM (	SELECT DeptID, COUNT(0) EmpCount
FROM dye.h_Employee
WHERE ISNULL(IsOut,0)=0
GROUP BY DeptID ) a
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
SELECT h.DeptID,  SUM(ISNULL(r.WorkCount,0)) AS WorkCount,  SUM(ISNULL(r.NoWork,0)) NoWork, SUM(CONVERT(INT, ISNULL(r.IsHoliday,0))) IsHoliday ,SUM(ISNULL(r.IsLeave,0)) IsLeave
FROM #r r
LEFT OUTER JOIN dye.h_Employee h
ON h.EmpID = r.EmpID
WHERE h.DeptID IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(IsOut,0)=0
GROUP BY h.DeptID )
c
ON c.DeptID = a.DeptID

inserts.sql: SELECT m.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, m.ShiftID AS ShiftID, m.EmpID AS EmpID, SUM(m.Qty) AS Qty, m.EndTime AS EndTime, 'GX20' AS ProcessID FROM (SELECT b.BarCode AS BarCode, a.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, a.ShiftID AS ShiftID, b.EmpID AS EmpID, a.CustQty AS CustQty, a.CustQty / c.pre AS Qty, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(HOUR, -8, a.PackTime), 20) AS EndTime FROM dye.RecordYield AS a JOIN dye.RecordEmp AS b ON b.BarCode = a.BarCode LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift ON p_Shift.ShiftID = a.ShiftID JOIN (SELECT b.BarCode AS BarCode, COUNT(b.BarCode) AS pre FROM dye.RecordEmp AS b WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY b.BarCode) AS c ON c.BarCode = b.BarCode WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dye.WProcess AS w WHERE w.ProcessID = 'GX73' AND w.JobSheetNo = a.JobSheetNo) AND (a.PackTime >= @dtDate) AND (a.PackTime <= @edDate)) AS m GROUP BY m.JobSheetNo, m.ShiftID, m.EmpID, m.EndTime

SELECT JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, RecordYield.ShiftID AS ShiftID, COUNT(BarCode) AS CurrRolls, SUM(CustQty) AS CurrKg FROM dye.RecordYield LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift ON p_Shift.ShiftID = RecordYield.ShiftID WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dye.WProcess AS w WHERE w.ProcessID = 'GX73' AND w.JobSheetNo = dye.RecordYield.JobSheetNo) AND (PackTime >= @dtDate) AND (PackTime <= @edDate) GROUP BY JobSheetNo, RecordYield.ShiftID

SELECT CAST(NEWID() AS VARCHAR(50)) AS ID, j.OrderSheetNo AS OrderSheetNo, j.CustomerID AS CustomerID, j.ProdID AS ProdID, j.ColorNum AS ColorNum, j.ColorID AS ColorID, a.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, a.ProcessID AS ProcessID, ps.Name AS ShiftName, a.ShiftID AS ShiftID, a.EmpID AS EmpID, CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), a.EndTime, 120) AS YEARS, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),a.EndTime,120) AS StartTime, a.EndTime AS DAYS, b.CurrRolls AS CurrRolls, b.CurrKg AS CurrKg, a.Qty AS Qty, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.IsAbroad, 0) = 0 THEN p.Price ELSE p.Price * 1.5 END, 2) AS Price, ROUND((CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.IsAbroad, 0) = 0 THEN p.Price ELSE p.Price * 1.5 END) * a.Qty / 1000, 2) AS WorkMoney FROM dye.PackWorkQtyDetail AS a JOIN dye.PackWorkSumQty AS b ON b.JobSheetNo = a.JobSheetNo AND b.ShiftID = a.ShiftID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Process AS p ON p.ProcessID = a.ProcessID LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS j ON a.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer AS pc ON j.CustomerID = pc.CustomerID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift AS ps ON a.ShiftID = ps.ShiftID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.EndTime >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @dtDate, 20) AND a.EndTime <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @edDate, 20) UNION ALL SELECT a.WProcessNo, d.OrderSheetNo, d.CustomerID, d.ProdID, d.ColorNum, d.ColorID, a.JobSheetNo, a.ProcessID, ps.Name AS ShiftName, a.ShiftID, b.EmpID, CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), a.EndTime, 120) AS YEARS, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),a.EndTime,120) AS StartTime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(HOUR, -8, a.EndTime), 20) AS DAYS, CurrRolls, CurrKg, CurrKg / c.pre AS Qty, p.Price, ROUND((CurrKg / 1000) / c.pre, 2) AS WorkMoney FROM dye.WProcess AS a JOIN dye.JobShiftEmp AS b ON a.JobSheetNo = b.JobSheetNo AND a.ShiftID = b.ShiftID AND a.ProcessID = b.ProcessID AND a.WProcessNo = b.WProcessNo AND a.ProcessNo = b.ProcessNo JOIN (SELECT JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ProcessNo AS ProcessNo, ProcessID AS ProcessID, COUNT(ShiftID) AS pre FROM dye.JobShiftEmp GROUP BY JobSheetNo, ShiftID, ProcessNo, ProcessID) AS c ON b.JobSheetNo = c.JobSheetNo AND b.ShiftID = c.ShiftID AND b.ProcessNo = c.ProcessNo AND b.ProcessID = c.ProcessID JOIN dye.JobSheet AS d ON a.JobSheetNo = d.SheetNo JOIN dye.p_Process AS p ON a.ProcessID = p.ProcessID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift AS ps ON a.ShiftID = ps.ShiftID WHERE a.ProcessID = 'GX73' AND a.EndTime >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @dtDate, 20) AND a.EndTime <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @edDate, 20)

SELECT NEWID() AS ID, a.EmpID AS EmpID, a.EmpID AS EmpCode, dtDate AS dtDate, CAST(RIGHT(dtDate, 2) AS VARCHAR(10)) AS TDAY, a.ShiftName AS YEARS, b.Qty AS Qty, b.WorkMoney AS WorkMoney, ROUND(b.SumMoney, 2) AS SumMoney, a.DeptID AS DeptID, b.ShiftID AS ShiftID FROM dye.EmpShiftClock AS a LEFT JOIN dye.v_DPWorkQtyALL AS b ON b.EmpID = a.EmpID AND a.dtDate = b.DAYS AND a.ShiftName = b.YEARS WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.ShiftName = @DDays AND b.SumMoney > 0 AND b.WorkMoney > 0
